thread:
Priya (Sales): incoming security packet from MediLine. They uploaded a CAIQ + an 8-page BYOK/KMS appendix. POC kickoff this Fri; they asked for CAIQ responses + evidence before then. @Marco can security triage and give ETA?
Marco - SecEng: will do. please attach the zip here or point to drive link. Any PHI mentioned?
Leah (SE): yes, they'll ingest patient notes for summarization. Expect occasional full PHI docs. We'll try to route PHI workloads to Dedicated but need security sign-off.
Priya (Sales): files linked: https://medi-line.share/mediline-sectools.zip (redacted). They also included vendor list + HSM vendor preferences.
SecIntakeBot: Ticket created: RWD-5310  Security intake for MediLine (CAIQ + BYOK).
Marco - SecEng: quick triage: high items = BYOK/HSM integration, encrypted telemetry retention, BAA, sub-processor list, certs (SOC2, ISO27001), pen-test summary. LegalOps  will MediLine sign a BAA?
LegalOps: We're in contact. MediLine prelim agreed to BAA, LegalOps expects countersign this week but can't promise pre-PoC.
Evan (Pricing): heads-up: Dedicated + BYOK + BAA + extended log retention will change commercials. Ballpark +40% list price and SOW for BYOK work. Also ramp time 2-3 weeks for enterprise onboarding.
Marco - SecEng: triage plan: 1) CAIQ draft answers (initial pass)  24-48 hours, 2) evidence bundle (certs/pen test)  3-6 business days pending infra pulls, 3) BYOK design workshop with infra/SE/legal  schedule in 5-7 business days. If they need BYOK live for POC it's probably infeasible.
Priya (Sales): customer asks: can we do a "BYOK lite" for POC (bring keys but not full HSM)?
Marco - SecEng: BYOK lite = risky. We can offer a mitigated approach: no PHI on hosted, ephemeral key wrap for POC, or run PHI only on Dedicated with queued integration. Need SE and infra to confirm.
Leah (SE): I can propose workflow: POC uses pseudonymized data or Dedicated routing for PHI. I'll prep notes and sample prompts.
infra-team: INF-907 opened to collect SOC2/ISO cert links and KMS diagrams. We can share redacted architecture diagrams in 24-48 hrs.
SecIntakeBot: RWD-5310 status -> in_progress (owners: Marco - SecEng, Leah (SE)).
Marco - SecEng: action items assigned: Marco = CAIQ answers + risk notes, infra-team = evidence links + diagrams, LegalOps = BAA chase, Leah = POC data flow and prompt examples.
Evan (Pricing): please also capture expected commitment term. If they want month-to-month with BYOK it's a different price than 12mo commit.
Priya (Sales): MediLine indicated at least a 6mo pilot, possible enterprise after pilot. I'll confirm exact term.
Marco - SecEng: setting expectations: CAIQ initial answers will be conservative; anything requiring third-party evidence will be marked "evidence pending". BYOK will be marked as "design review required" with estimated timeline.
Leah (SE): sample traffic profile: steady 8 rps, bursts to 30 rps, ~150k tokens/day, 90% embeddings+summary, occasional PDF OCR.
Marco - SecEng: good. I'll annotate control mappings to their risk areas and highlight where Dedicated/Private deployment is required.
SecIntakeBot: RWD-5310 comment: "evidence requested: SOC2 report, ISO27001 certificate, pen test summary, HSM vendor attestation, sub-processor disclosures".
Priya (Sales): noted, will ask them for vendor docs and try to expedite BAA.
Evan (Pricing): I'll draft alternate commercial scenarios (hosted w/o PHI, hosted w/ pseudonymization, Dedicated+BYOK) and post here.
Marco - SecEng: target: CAIQ draft by EOD tomorrow, evidence bundle in 3-6 days. BYOK workshop invite next week. If something changes I'll update this thread.
Priya (Sales): thanks, team. marking urgent and keeping customer in the loop. :mailbox_with_mail:
SecIntakeBot: RWD-5310 status -> evidence_requested
Marco - SecEng: closing triage for now. escalate if LegalOps doesn't get BAA signed within 5 business days.
Priya (Sales): thanks everyone. I'll ping if they push for BYOK earlier. :thumbsup:
